घुष् 1. घुष्, cl. 1. P. घोषति, जुघोष,
घोषिष्यति, अघोषीत् and अघुषत्,
घोषितुम्, to sound, make any sound or noise;
to cry or proclaim aloud, call out, announce publicly,
declare; to fill with cries; (according to some) to kill:
Caus. घोषयति, -यितुम्, अजूघुषत्, to proclaim
aloud, call to, invite; to cause to proclaim aloud;
to praise: Desid. जुघुषिषति or जुघोषिषति:
Intens. जोघुष्यते, जोघोष्टि.
घुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, declared, proclaimed.

घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, proclaimed.
—घु-
ष्टान्न (˚ट-अन्न), अम्, n. food given away by
proclamation.

घुष्ट्र, अम्, n. a cart, a carriage; (fr. घुष्,
in the sense ‘to creak ?’).

घुष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, giving out sounds; to be
proclaimed aloud.
